pkgmetadata.longdescription: oh-my-posh is a prompt theme engine for any shell, written in Go. This package installs upstream's own prebuilt per-architecture binaries rather than building from source: a source build is also practical (upstream publishes a vendored Go module cache tarball alongside each release), but -bin was kept for simplicity now that the packaged binaries' full embedded dependency tree has been audited (see files/NOTICE.deps.txt) -- 30 compiled-in third-party Go modules, all MIT, Apache-2.0, or BSD, none copyleft. The Apache-2.0 NOTICE text from go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 (formerly Canonical's go-yaml) is preserved and installed verbatim as NOTICE.go.yaml.in-yaml-v3.
